Big wave surfer Jesse challenges Tommy and Jules. Tommy performs two rescues of intoxicated tourists. Reidy pursues a creepy guy on the beach. There are Beard Season skin checks, and a Danish backpacker bares all on Bondi Beach.

Singlets returns to work, performing his first rescue since the tragic drowning of a Norwegian man. Pierre from Hong Kong fulfills a dream by visiting the tower after saving all his money to meet the Bondi Rescue lifeguards. Hoppo imparts valuable lessons to kids on surviving in a rip.

On New Year's Eve, lifeguards Harries and Kerrbox contend with drunk swimmers. Backpackers steal the lifeguard buggy. A shark sighting leads to the evacuation of a crowd of 40,010 people from the water. Chaos ensues when a woman reports her baby abducted by another woman.

Lifeguards lay down the law after a woman reports being spat on at Bondi Beach. New lifeguard Will attends a medical emergency involving an unconscious teenager. In the midst of a howling gale, a woman brings a fleet of giant inflatables to Bondi. Local larrikin Harries helps tame the wild toys.

Tragedy unfolds as a Chinese backpacker is left comatose after-hours. A father loses his son in a massive crowd. Lifeguards struggle communicating with the distressed Cambodian man. Former ironman Kailan Collins shares the details of his rare injury for the first time in seventeen years.

Three new 18-year-old Bondi lifeguards‚ Dylan, Chase, and Noah now carry the weight of the Bondi community on their shoulders. Chase mans the tower alone, Dylan's maturity is revealed during a spinal incident, and master lifeguard Hoppo apprehends a thief off the beach.

Chappo and H-man cautiously prepare a 19 year old German tourist for hospital after he's broken his back. Trainees Taco and Jesse have a difficult day in class struggling with the books, but get a chance to make the grade against the rest of the team in the annual lifeguard challenge.

Amidst the bustling crowds at Bondi, two men start drowning at the north end. Californian bodybuilder Ike Catcher arrives to challenge Harries for the 'King-of-Bondi' title. The real King-of-Bondi test is the annual lifeguard challenge, when everyone races to decide which lifeguard is the fastest.

2016 dawns on Bondi with drug and alcohol-affected masses taking lifeguards to another level. A 300-person-strong Dutch contingent raises the stakes even further. Nicola loses her cool with beachgoers, and Singlets and Mario lose their cool with each other.

Christmas crowds at Bondi overwhelm lifeguards. Caught between minor rescues and serious situations, Maxi makes a wrong decision. Jake struggles with numerous rescues on the jetski. Jackson rushes through the crowd to save a drunk woman in a rip, earning a surprising Christmas kiss.

Hundreds of Dutch tourists hit Bondi for a New Years swim - straight in to Backpackers Rip. A diabetic comes to the tower with low blood sugar, and then suffers an epileptic fit. Troy uses the Lifeguard security camera to identify a group of bag thieves operating on Bondi.
New Years Eve in Bondi  a beach event with hundreds of participants leads the group directly into a rip  a painful ending for a German tourist.

Sailing to Baghdad after a narrow escape from the monster island of Colossa, the wedding plans of legendary hero Sinbad and Princess Parisa are spoiled by the scheming sorcerer Sokurah. In return for his previous help with the cyclops on Colossa, Sokurah demands that Sinbad retrieve a lamp he lost on the island. When Sinbad refuses, the conjurer shrinks Parisa, forcing the sailor and his crew back to the high seas in order to save her.

When her brother is murdered, China Valdez (Jennifer Jones) swears revenge on the corrupt Cuban government he had been protesting. She joins the resistance led by Tony (John Garfield), an American with a plan that promises devastating results to their enemies. First they'll kill a government official, then plant a bomb at the funeral, which will wipe out the dead man's associates when it explodes. All they need to do is to dig an underground tunnel from China's house to the cemetery next door.

Veteran secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) is living a life of luxury when his former lover, Tina Batori (Daliah Lavi), pulls him back into action. A sinister group known as the Big O has developed a plot to start a global nuclear conflict, so the carefree, womanizing Helm must stop the scheme of mastermind Tung-Tze (Victor Buono). Joining the suave Helm on his mission is the beautiful but inept operative Gail Hendricks (Stella Stevens), along with other gorgeous ladies.

Song Ah becomes all too aware that people are saying Joon Young is on a different level than she is. She loses confidence and keeps trying to distance herself from Joon Young. Meanwhile, Joon Young reacts coldly when he finds Jung Kyung in front of his house. Afterward, Joon Young calls Song Ah, saying he has something to tell her.

Song Ah and Joon Young finally realize they have mutual feelings for one another, and they have a few blissful moments together. Meanwhile, Hyeon Ho finds out about Joon Young and Song Ah's relationship and gets angry. The stress caused by his broken friendship and the seemingly perpetual cycle of preparing for competitions starts to wear on Joon Young.

Seong Jae suggests that Joon Young talks about his family on TV for publicity. Joon Young feels both insulted and ashamed, but he holds his ground. Meanwhile, Song Ah asks Joon Young if she can visit his place. She keeps feeling Jun Kyung's presence around Joon Young both at his apartment and later on at school.

Seong Jae finds out that Song Ah and Joon Young are dating and calls her for a chat. His bluntness hurts her feelings. Later on, Joon Young joins Song Ah on a sudden trip to Daejeon and shows her around the neighborhood where he grew up. After an unexpected meeting with his mother, Joon Young opens up to Song Ah about more personal matters.

Song Ah has to look for a new accompanist when her last one quits. She asks her acquaintances for help, but she has no luck. Just then, Joon Young offers to play for her. People find out that Song Ah and Joon Young are dating and that Joon Young is playing for Song Ah's grad school exam. Rumors about them spread like wildfire, which makes Song Ah doubt if she made the right decision. Meanwhile, Joon Young looks for paid work performing at a concert.

With Jung Kyung constantly asking Joon Young whether he still has feelings for her, Joon Young once again tells her how he feels. Later, Song Ah questions Joon Young about his whereabouts last night after seeing him and Jung Kyung ride off in a taxi. When Director Nah asks Joon Young a favor regarding Jung Kyung, he turns down her request. Meanwhile, Song Ah is going through a hard time herself and makes a decision that should've been made a long time ago.

Chae Yoon is shocked when he finds out that So Yi is the manual. Lee Do's secret mission has ultimately failed and the court ladies find themselves in trouble. Meanwhile, Lee Do asks Lee Shin Juck if he is a member of Secret Roots.

Shim Jong Soo asks Jung Ki Joon to give up his position as leader of Secret Roots for the manual. Lee Do has finally set the date for the proclamation of the creation of his new alphabet which makes Jung Ki Joon angry.
Chae Yoon races to find So Yi who has been hit with a poisoned arrow. Lee Do can't wait for them to return to proclaim the creation of his new alphabet. The ceremony is about to start.

Lee Soon receives a letter and ends up meeting Ok Jung. He grows lost in thought, thinking he has seen her face somewhere before. Meanwhile, Ok Jung seeks out Jo Sa Seok's wife and asks him to free her mother. From her uncle, Jang Hyeon, she hears of his dangerous ambition. Ok Jung is the only one who can realize his wish, so how about swallowing Joseon together?

Jang Hyeon went to Buyongjeong to take young Ok Jung with him. But he is disconcerted by Madam Kang's question, do you know my brother? Meanwhile, young Lee Soon, seeing pickpocketers steal from young Ok Jung, gets into a fight while helping her. Ok Jung takes Lee Soon with her and they run away.

Ok Jung, through Jang Hyeon's help, is reunited with her long-lost brother Hee Jae. Hee Jae introduces her to Prince Dongpyeong, saying he met him in China. Also, Ok Jung, at Inkyeong's request to chaperone her at the Crown Princess selection, decides to help, saying it's a chance to see palace fashion.

During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them.

The Emperor has returned! After the Shane Gang failed to defeat the Iron Warrior, the Emperor sets to work creating even more Unstoppable Warriors to reclaim the Eastern Caverns. The Shane Gang search for a way to defeat the new creations, but when the Emperor places a bounty on Junjie's head, they also have to deal with the Dai-Fu and hordes of the Emperor's Underlords.

programmes.st: The Return of the Eastern Champion
programmes.d: Junjie, Eli and the Gang rally their friends and even some old enemies-to help them take down the Emperor.

The Shane Gang return home to the 99 caverns to find Gateway Cavern overrun with slugs-in Eli's absence, the Shadow Clan have governed by putting the slugs before the people, and the result is chaos! It's up to Eli to restore the balance, but the Shadow Clan aren't as friendly as they once were...and that's saying something. Help comes from an unexpected source-Tad and his slug Pieper, who just arrived from the Surface!

The Shane Gang take Tad under their wing, training him to blast like a pro with Eli's old blaster and teaching him to live by the slugslinger's code. Tad takes to it like a natural, and as Kord says, it looks like they have another "slugslinging savant from the Surface" on their hands. But their training will be put to the test when Tad accompanies them to a showdown with the Scrap Force...and the Shadow Clan!

Tad is still missing after the slug-out with the Shadow Clan, but the Gang have to set off without him when reports start coming in of slugs disappearing all across the 99 caverns. As they pursue the trail of missing slugs, the mystery grows darker when it leads them straight to Dr. Blakk's old stronghold!

Tad's hypnotic slug Pieper has gone megamorph, his gang of supporters all have Gattler blasters, and Tad's control over his army of ghouls is stronger than Dr. Blakk's ever was. The Shane Gang are under non-stop ghoul fire as they struggle to put a stop to Tad's plans and end the mass ghouling of slugs once and for all.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 1
programmes.d: 15-year-old Eli Shane is a regular kid except for one thing: he comes from a long line of Shanes, each who has journied from the surface to protect Slugterra and the slugs that make the world special.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 2
programmes.d: Now its Eli's turn to be Slugterra's next Shane, whether he's ready or not! Unfortunately, the slugslinging tournament he enters to prove that he's ready, pretty quickly shows that he's not!

After the Shane hideout is ransacked, the gang trades in one of Eli's prized slugs for new gear. When Eli has second thoughts they go back to get it, only to learn that it's been sold to Dr. Blakk, along with hundreds of others to be transformed into feral Ghoul Slugs. Eli refuses to let his slug or any other get ghouled, so the team breaks in to Blakk's fortress to free them. While inside, they learn of Blakk's plan to conquer Slugterra.
When the punks in the Hooligang cruise into Quiet Lawn Cavern, they think no one there's got the guts to stand up to them so they trash the place.
The gang signs up for a weekend camp that promises to teach your slugs tons of new moves - without lifting a finger!

The Slug Run is the ultimate, off-road, no-holds-barred, cross-cavern Mecha Beast race. Unfortunately, the only thing lower than the odds of beating the three-time champ who's now racing for Dr. Blakk are the odds of Eli making it to the finish line in one piece!
When even Kord can't find a way to fix what's wrong with the new upgrades to the Shane Gang's Mecha Beasts, it's time to go to the source: the wondrous Mecha Forge!
Eli doesn't believe in ghosts - until he enters Deadweed cavern! But it turns out Eli's first instinct was right.

When Wes Weasley returns to the Fortress, Coconuts tricks Robotnik into signing an IOU so he can buy thousands of Mobiums worth of magic tricks to use on Sonic. In the end, Sonic goes free, and Robotnik is forced to pay Wes the massive IOU debt.

Sonic plays Cyrano to bring Robotnik Jr. and Breezie together. The problem is, Breezie's crazy about Sonic. So Sonic gets out of the way, but when he does, Junior is captured by Robotnik, and Breezie comes to the rescue, finally falling for him.

When Tails invents a Hover-Hanglider for Sonic's birthday, Sonic suggests he assist Prof. Von Schlemmer with his new Robotnik-Nabber machine. Robotnik hears about this, and poses as Von Schlemmer to trick Tails into inventing a Sonic-Nabber instead.
A female space hunter named Katella, who is capturing animals all over Mobius for a Zoo, teams up with Robotnik and captures Sonic. To Robotnik's great fear, she then plans to marry the eggman!

Robotnik invents a giant AMNESIA RAY in his booby-trapped PINBALL FORTRESS (based on the Sonic game per Roger Hector) in order to erase the bad memories the Mobius citizens have of him, and make them think he's a great guy.
Robotnik decides to cripple Mobius' three major transit systems: Rail, Air, and Sea in order to fully gain control of the planet. Sonic has to circumnavigate the planet in order to save the day.

Robotnik invents a robot coach -- the "Coachnik", to put S and G through a "Training Camp" to improve their skills. Then Coachnik puts a bomb in Grounder's head as a booby trap for Sonic, and a football game ensues with Grounder's head as the ball.
Sonic and Tails help out an Owl/Chilidog Diner owner, named Bert Whoo, when Robotnik uses his henchbots to try to collect protection money. When the henchbots prove to be no match for Sonic.

Coconuts inadvertantly creates a "super power" formula, when his janitor bucket spills in the lab. Robotnik falls into it and becomes "Super Robotnik", then challenges Sonic to a fight, with all of Mobius as the stakes. With Prof. Von...

When Sonic and The Freedom Fighters take out Robotnik's main computer, they're trapped by Swat-Bots in an underground tunnel, only to be rescued by a handsome teenager named Griff. Griff takes them deep beneath the Big City.
Robotnik severely upsets the ecosystem above and below the surface, when he sends explosive, Robotnik snake probes drilling deep under ground in search of oil lakes.

Tails brings a new friend home to Knothole - a baby Terra-Pod who has strayed from the herd that is currently migrating. Sonic, Sally, and some of the other Freedom Fighters return the Baby-T to its mom and the rest of the herd.

programmes.d: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.
Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.

Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures that ends with Apple finding a new home with Strawberry and her friends.

Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.
When a comedy of errors causes Orange, Plum and Cherry to arrive late to their campout, they start off their annual tradition of telling tall-tales around the campfire.

At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." She tries to get Sweet to participate in spinning the tale, but Sour's over-the-top performance leaves Sweet behind. Toward the end, Sour graciously changes the story to pull Sweet into it, giving Sweet the opportunity to toss in an ad lib that makes a nice topper to Sour's story.

Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. When Strawberry's stuffed-up nose makes her bake a bad-tasting cake, Apple, afraid the truth will hurt Strawberry's reputation, proclaims it's delicious. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. After the girls' feud disrupts the town, they are sentenced in a Berry Bitty City-style trial to camp alone together for a whole weekend. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.
Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.

When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

Tyr returns, having joined with the Collectors and demanding the Route of Ages from his former crewmates.

programmes.st: The World Turns All Around Her
programmes.d: A hostage situation ensues when the crew confronts Tyr. Beka is rescued, Tyr is killed, and Trance reveals her true nature.
A wrong turn in the slipstream leads Andromeda to a prison riot. When the dust settles, they discover a prisoner missing.
The Andromeda crew steps up to find out who killed a group of scientists and locate the kidnapped one.
The crew is hired to rescue a princess from a notorious outlaw, but it is soon revealed that she was trying to escape murder at her father's hand.
The Collectors now control the Commonwealth and put the Andromeda crew on trial.
Andromeda discovers a shipment of bio-armor, with terrifying results.

programmes.st: The Warmth of an Invisible Light
programmes.d: An experimental cloaking device drops Dylan in an alternate universe, where he learns how to save the Andromeda - assuming he can get back to his own reality.
The Andromeda gets caught in a war between two ships that includes a fatal disease - one that Dylan picks up.
Dylan is tricked by Rev and kidnapped. The crew finds an "unexpected ally" in a Collector.

programmes.st: Lost in a Space That Isn't There
programmes.d: The Abyss has infected Beka. The crew must find a way to save her.
After some of the crew is captured, Harper is forced to work on a time bridge for the Patriarch.
A spy from Tri Gemma shows up on the Andromeda in an attempt to steal the Star Map.
Jotaro and the others next head toward Varanasi. On their way there, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen. At first, it doesn't bother him much, but the bigger it gets, the creepier it looks.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Wheel of Fortune
programmes.d: Jotaro and his group head toward Pakistan by car. Polnareff is behind the wheel on a dangerous mountain road when a mysterious vehicle starts impeding their progress.
After surviving another attack, Jotaro and his team make it to Pakistan, where they stop at an inn to rest. The village around the inn, however, is quiet, and its inhabitants rather odd.
Polnareff realizes that Enyaba is a new assassin sent by DIO. He is prevented from warning his comrades by Enyaba's Stand "Justice," which has the ability to control corpses.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 1
programmes.d: After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Dan of Steel.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Lovers Part 2
programmes.d: Dan of Steel's Stand, "The Lovers," has entered Joseph's brain. With Joseph's life on the line, Jotaro has no choice but to carry out Dan's orders, but the rest of his companions have their own say in the matter.
Jotaro and his fellows take camels and travel across the desert, headed for Cairo. Along the way, though, they can't shake the sensation that someone or something is watching their every move.

Kakyoin dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream he witnesses Death cut down a dog, but after waking up in terror he can't remember what the nightmare was about.
Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains, and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.
Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association, Hellish Blizzard issues an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master’s stalker.
Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S-Class hero 'Tanktop Master.'
Metal Bat guards some VIPs while Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.
After suffering a mortal wound, Shizuka dies in Ichiru’s arms. Meanwhile, Yuki and Zero try to find where Shizuka may have gone, but Zero is constantly thwarted by his Level E seizures…
After Shizuka Hio’s death, peace is restored at the academy. As usual, Yuki is busy with her duties as Guardian when Zero, who has been gone for quite some time, comes back.
Yuki has a lot on her mind after almost being kissed by Zero. She asserts that she will not speak to Kaname until he admits to Zero’s innocence.
The Night Class goes to the Aido family’s vacation home during the long break, but Hanabusa decides to stay at the academy because he suspects Kaname had something to do with Shizuka’s death.
Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself.
L's team discovers that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company.
The Yotsuba Group hires Eraldo Coil to uncover L's identity.
Misa succeeds in narrowing down the Kira suspects in the Yotsuba Group to one: Higuchi.
Higuchi of the Yotsuba Group attempts to kill Matsuda of the task force, and is surprised when he doesn't die after 40 seconds.
Higuchi is captured and tells the investigators about the Death Note.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira stops by a showroom in Saitama to get an RV. There he is reunited with Shizuka.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: With Kosugi in complete control of his mind, Akira makes an astonishing decision.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.st: Sushi & Hot Springs of the Dead
programmes.d: The gang runs into a German college student named Beatrix, who slices through a zombie!

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira and his friends run into a man named Kumano, who is constructing a treehouse in the forest.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Higurashi prepares to take his revenge on society, and sets his plan into action.

programmes.t: Zom 100: Bucket List of the Dead (English Dubbed)
programmes.d: Akira and his friends split up to save the villagers from the massive swarm of zombies.

programmes.t: Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: God
programmes.d: On the surface, peace seems to have been restored in Tokyo. Beasts still remain captured and are exterminated on a daily basis.

programmes.t: Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Man
programmes.d: Defeat of Jun at the hands of Lan is witnessed throughout the world. Government leaders hail Lan's victory and proclaims her as child of God who will bring a thousand years of peace.

Office worker Mizuki is tasked with discovering what causes an inpatient to become a ghost at a certain hospital. He meets a dying pregnant woman from the Ghost tribe while investigating, and soon enough he is told: The ghost at the hospital is dead…

The awakened Yasha and Vampire Dracula fight for one prey: the president of a company, the person who commissioned Mizuki to investigate the cause of the ghost inpatient. Due to Mizuki’s disappearance, the president is brought to the brink of bankruptcy.

Mizuki comes back from hell. A singer, Trump Shigei, meets Mizuki and learns about the existence of the ominous Kitaro. One night, Rat Man plants a seed of the vampire tree in Shigei’s body, turning the frightened Shigei into a tree gradually…

programmes.st: Tim Medhurst and Irita Marriott, Day 2
programmes.d: Tim and Irita's second trip. She's on top and in the Suffolk pink, while he has a bit of a break down before giving her a terrible fright. Will bidders love the sweetheart brooch?

programmes.st: Tim Medhurst and Irita Marriott, Day 3
programmes.d: On a journey through Bedfordshire that includes airships and tractors, Irita splashes her cash on fine silver while Tim goes for bargain basement. But who'll clean up at auction?

programmes.st: Tim Medhurst and Irita Marriott, Day 4
programmes.d: Tim takes up West Country skittles while Irita spins a good sailing yarn at an historic Somerset twine works. Both buy pig themed antiques but who'll be trotting home the victor?

programmes.st: Tim Medhurst and Irita Marriott, Day 5
programmes.d: A very old clock is ticking for Tim at Salisbury Cathedral on the last leg of his trip with Irita. She's currently out in front but could he become the tortoise to her hare?

programmes.st: Paul Martin and Raj Bisram, Day 1
programmes.d: Antiques dealer Paul Martin makes his Road Trip debut alongside seasoned tripper Raj Bisram. A mysterious giant and very cute dog also feature in this South Downs adventure.

programmes.st: Paul Martin and Raj Bisram, Day 2
programmes.d: The Road Trip continues in Wiltshire for debutant Paul Martin and seasoned chum Raj Bisram. Will a gamble buy of antique jelly moulds cause an auction wobble for one expert?

programmes.st: Paul Martin and Raj Bisram, Day 3
programmes.d: Raj Bisram and Paul Martin explore antique shops in the West Country. At auction an expensive biscuit tin leaves a foul taste while a cheap oil painting makes an impression.

programmes.st: Paul Martin and Raj Bisram, Day 4
programmes.d: Antiques expert chums, Raj Bisram and Paul Martin take their open-topped motor to Dorset, Devon, Somerset and beyond. Will they make profits at the Worcestershire auction?

programmes.st: Paul Martin and Raj Bisram, Day 5
programmes.d: Raj Bisram and Paul Martin reach Shakespeare country, to buy or not to buy? Plus, they meet alpacas and do some ballet. Expect Incas, tutus and tights.

programmes.st: Steven Moore and Natasha Raskin Sharp, Day 1
programmes.d: A new Road Trip sees Steven Moore find some pricey porcelain in an antique shop loo, while Natasha Raskin Sharp disappears down a secret tunnel on a journey back in time.

programmes.st: Steven Moore and Natasha Raskin Sharp, Day 2
programmes.d: Northumberland sees Natasha on safari tracking ancient creatures while Steven finds an old elephant. Both experts go Georgian with their treasures going under the gavel in Dundee.

programmes.st: Steven Moore and Natasha Raskin Sharp, Day 3
programmes.d: Steven and Natasha visit the Scottish Borders. They reveal the hidden past of the Roman Empire and an antique hiding a secret. Expect more surprises at the Edinburgh auction.

programmes.st: Steven Moore and Natasha Raskin Sharp, Day 4
programmes.d: The Scottish antique buying adventure continues for Steven and Natasha. The pricey purchase of some militaria proves costly, and an unassuming lantern attracts big bids.

programmes.st: Steven Moore and Natasha Raskin Sharp, Day 5
programmes.d: A trip through Scotland sees Natasha get to grips with haggis and Steven falls for an exquisite French lady. It's the last auction of this adventure, who will take Road Trip crown?

programmes.st: Phillip Serrell and Izzie Balmer, Day 1
programmes.d: A new adventure for Izzie Balmer and Philip Serrell, who scour the shops of Kent in search of antiques. Expect rocking horse riding, cat whispering and disagreements about scarves.

programmes.st: Phillip Serrell and Izzie Balmer, Day 2
programmes.d: Back on the road with Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell as they hunt for elusive antique treasures. A gamble on some brown furniture may prove profitable at the Hertfordshire auction.

programmes.st: Phillip Serrell and Izzie Balmer, Day 3
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer and Phil Serrell are driving through a downpour in Oxfordshire on the trail of treasures. Will a long-lost saucer or designer brooch most excite the Harrogate auction?

programmes.t: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
programmes.d: Jimmie & his best friend Mont try to reclaim the home built by Jimmie's grandfather, launching them on a poignant odyssey that connects them to their past, even as it tests their friendship & sense of belonging in the place they call home.
From executive producer John Legend comes the touching love story inspired by the romantic first date between President Barack Obama and the First Lady.
A troubled sailor who embarks on a remarkable journey to confront his past.

A fine drama set during World War II, in which a black military attorney investigates the death of a black sergeant. The lawyer eventually discovers that the sergeant was both ashamed of his own culture and virulently hated by his men.

Rejected by his mother and with few options, a young, gay Black man joins the Marines, doing whatever it takes to succeed in a system that would cast him aside, unexpectedly finding camaraderie, strength, and support in this new community.

A look at three defining chapters in the life of Chiron, a young Black man growing up in Miami. His epic journey to manhood is guided by the kindness, support, and love of the community that helps raise him.
Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!
Webster's sorrow over the death of his pet increases when he's told animals don't go to heaven.
Webster's gangster-musical fantasy builds to a climactic moment in Dirty Sammy's speak-easy.
When Katherine's rich uncle falls in love with the leading lady of a theatrical performance, Webster and Katherine's debuts are in danger.

programmes.st: Doing Time at the Community Center
programmes.d: A convicted gambler undergoing rehab has a profound influence on Webster.
Katherine joins a bowling league hoping to persuade the sponsors to help with one of her programs, unaware they are such horrible people.
Tia considers taking a summer internship with the WNBA in New York. Meanwhile, Lisa worries about her upcoming wedding.
Lisa gets cold feet on her wedding day, while Tia and Tamera entertain an anxious crowd waiting for the ceremony.
Once separated at birth, identical twins Tia and Tamera, rediscover each other and scheme to live under one roof with their adoptive parents, who have nothing in common but their love for the girls.
Tia and Tamera vie for dates to the big school dance, while Ray and Lisa clash over the rules of the house.
The boyfriend of one of Tia and Tamera's slumber party guests crashes the bash, while Lisa discovers that her beau is stepping out with another woman.
Mo is shirking her duties at home and her grades are falling.  Frank blames Q.
Moesha is sentenced to do errands for an old woman who lives down the block because she stole oranges from her tree.
Mo is teaching a dance class to young girls.  Myles wants to join because he has a crush on one of the girls.
Crenshaw High’s basketball team is one game away from the city finals.
Moesha may have to bow out of the class trip to Africa when Frank invests all of the Mitchell savings in a Saturn dealership.
The tenants are thrilled when Rose hires a live-in handyman for some much needed repairs, only to find he's handier with the violin than the toolbox.
Mary has a terrible time trying to be polite to Fox, who is rude and obnoxious yet potentially important to Lester's financial future.
When Mary and Rose win the services of a butler in the church raffle, they look forward to the pampered life until they meet the pain-in-the-neck hired help.

Mary, Rose and Pearl may be sent 'up the river' after they go overboard defending '227' against a graffiti artist who then sues them for assault--and it seems even bleaker when the key to their defense is the testimony of a lone eyewitness--Sandra.
Eddie needs another job to get his prized tow truck repaired.
A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.
Malcolm and Eddie use their lottery winnings to buy their building from Kelly.
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.
Eddie is determined to keep Malcolm away from his younger sister.

Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.
Struggling black comic Lance Barton (Chris Rock) knows what it's like to die on stage. But when his life takes an unexpected turn - straight to heaven - Lance is sure there's been a mistake.
Four friends (Nicole Ari Parker, Tamala Jones, Kevin Hart, Keith Robinson) struggle to figure out where their lives are heading as they approach their mid-thirties.

Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.
Four friends conspire to turn the tables on their women when they discover the ladies have been using Steve Harvey's relationship advice against them.

All the couples are back for a wedding in Las Vegas, but plans for a romantic weekend go awry when their various misadventures get them into some compromising situations that threaten to derail the big event.

Producers T. D. Jakes and Tracey E. Edmonds invite you to the marriage of Sabrina Watson and Jason Taylor, who might be the perfect couple. Unfortunately, their families are a perfect recipe for disaster.
Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programmes.t: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programmes.d: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!
Sergeant Lane's home gets taken out from under him, Eli's mission to tear down the Black Hamptons brings the community together, and Bobby makes a big move to win over Peter.
In desperate need of her next hit, gospel queen and record executive Denita Jordan reaches a career crossroads when her son Taj endorses a traumatized rising star with a risqué reputation.
Taj goes against the family and brings a reluctant Rbel to meet his mother's rival Caesar at Redeeming Records, spurring a disaster during Denita's lifetime achievement award tribute.
Denita's scheming takes a turn for the worse in the wake of Rbel's Stellar Awards performance, a key piece of evidence is introduced in Dani's murder case, and Taj gets found out.
The Bishop Emeritus comes to town as Denita's empire crumbles, and Rbel refuses Caesar's gospel directives and considers recording a tribute track to her mother.
CJ ruffles some feathers with her proposed duet partner for Denita, Caesar sends Rbel to a songwriting boot camp to reach her full, godly potential, and Calvin has a special visitor.
Rbel's private investigation finds a member of the Kingdom family implicated in Dani's murder case, and Calvin must choose between Denita and his lover.
Malik tries to end things with Parker so he can live an honest life with Jenna, but things don't go exactly as planned.
When Tasha finds out her new man has a terminal illness, they spend his final days tackling their bucket lists.
After trying unsuccessfully to get pregnant, Melanie and Derwin visit a fertility specialist, but the visit to the fertility specialist reveals more than Melanie bargained for.
In the fifth season premiere, Melanie contends with Derwin's abortion accusation by leading him to believe he was the father of a child she terminated in college.
In the second half of the fifth season opener, Melanie reveals a huge confession to Derwin regarding the abortion that he assumed was of their child.
Melanie feels like something is missing in her life after Derwin goes back to Irv as his manager.
Melanie and Tasha's feud finds a public forum while preparing for the annual Sunbeams fashion show.
Jason's ego takes a hit when Chardonnay rejects his proposal about hooking up after their upcoming annulment.
Melanie has a showdown with Tasha at Drop Bar. Meanwhile, Malik has a hard time letting go of his dream home when he's forced to short sell his mansion.
Mary Jane joins forces with Justin, setting forth a plan that could oust Ronda from the anchor chair, but Kara gets caught in the crossfire.
Distrustful of Justin after Kara's firing, Mary Jane tries to make it work with Lee, but resisting Justin is undermining her performance in the coveted co-anchor spot of the morning show.
Since Kara is dealing with her wrongful termination claim, Mary Jane and Justin decide not to admit that they're seeing each other. Mary Jane finds herself in a position of having to lie. (S4, ep12)
Kara discovers Mary Jane is sleeping with Justin, their friendship tailspins and upsets the power dynamic at the studio. Helen sends Niecy to New York.
Mary Janes allows her own housewarming to be transformed into a media event promoting GDU as a big happy family. Niecy returns to Atlanta invigorated, while Patrick becomes a mentor.
Mary Jane and Justin's relationship goes viral. An old family friend of Helen and Paul's, stirs long-forgotten memories of a love triangle that clouded the early years of their marriage.
Mary Jane and Justin's relationship is tested when their notoriety on social media leads to discoveries about Justin's past.

A group of friends are magically transported inside a Christmas-themed board game during a holiday party. They must play through the game's levels to return home. They work together to survive and escape back to reality.
Two co-workers agree to a loveless marriage of convenience, but as they become acquainted, an unrealized chemistry grows between them.

Stan and Kelly Stevenson seem to be more committed to growing apart rather than growing together. Their friends are caught in the middle of divorce conversations during one of the most joyous seasons of the year.
Two exes finally reconnect when a snowstorm leaves them stranded in a superstore (without mobile service or Wi-Fi) just before Christmas.

Gerald Davenport has requested his three estranged daughters Diedre, Nicole, and Tammy come together for Christmas for a big announcement…he has won a $10-million-dollar lottery! To get their share, the sisters must repair their broken relationship.
When an unlucky businessman gambles away the mob's money, he's forced to go on the run and hide out as a shopping mall Santa Claus.
A struggling bar owner becomes the legal guardian of his niece when his sister dies before the holidays.
After the loss of her mother, a woman is visited by her father's spirit to keep the holiday spirit alive.

A heart-broken young woman home for the holidays feels the family pressure to date again. Her sister sets up an online date with her dream man, a pro athlete. But things are not always as they seem, and true love may be closer to home.
Faith must choose between taking over her father's church or handing it over to a new minister by Christmas.
Hakeem’s cousin transfers to their school and Moesha goes out with him.

programmes.st: Women Are From Mars, Men Are From Saturn
programmes.d: Moesha is off visiting cousins out of town.  Meanwhile, Dee thinks Frank is spending too much time with “the boys” including his brother Bernie.
Frank’s nephew (Mo’s cousin) is the family’s “bad seed” and no one likes him around.
Mo cries the lovesick blues on a phone-in radio show.  The DJ, feeling sorry for Mo, gives her four free tickets to an upcoming concert.
Although he is supposed to be home watching Drew and Tonya, Chris sneaks out to go to the movies with his friends and witnesses a shoot-out outside the theater.
Chris is just starting to fit in at his new high school when he gets asked on a date by the dorkiest girl in school, Kelly, whom everyone calls 'Big Bird.'

Julius realizes that the key to keeping Rochelle happy in their marriage is getting advice from 'The Oprah Winfrey Show.' Unfortunately, the plan backfires when Rochelle equates Julius' new attitude with an extramarital affair.
When Rochelle orders a copy of her birth certificate, she realizes that she is actually one year younger than she thought she was and decides to start living her life with a new, younger attitude.
Dee Dee starts dating a guy who, as it turns out, was Mona’s ex-high school boyfriend and her first.

programmes.st: The Big In With The In Crowd Episode
programmes.d: Mona and Dee Dee’s relationship gets sticky when Mona accuses Dee Dee of trying to change her just to fit in with her upscale group of friends.

programmes.st: The Big Thanks For Forgiving Episode
programmes.d: Big Dee Dee and Dee Dee jump through hoops on Thanksgiving to please Grandma Thorne (Carroll), who plays favorites with Phyllis and Mona.
When Mona and Dee Dee set Spencer up on blind dates, Spencer falls for her hard and fast
Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.
It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.
Mark, Vanessa and Geneva return to Oakland after their plans go awry. Geneva gets promoted to high school principal and wonders if she should rehire Mark.
Mark takes advantage of Geneva's position as high school principal. Vanessa refuses to return her wedding gifts, which gives Nicole and Tyler a naughty idea.
Mark becomes the faculty advisor for a student military program and learns that war games are no fun.
When Mark injures himself, Vanessa proves her medical skills.
Nicole dares Tyler to stay all night in a haunted house on Halloween.Halloween episode
Nicole feels guilty about lying and learns a lesson from a dream. Professional basketball player JULIUS "DR. J" ERVING guest stars as himself.
Nikki’s wedding has a shocking effect on Oglevee.
Cash-strapped college students Nikki and Kim Parker become a mother-daughter telephone psychic team.
When Nikki, Kim and Stevie pledge with a sorority they are ordered to 'expose' Professor Oglevee.
With Nikki’s help, the school geek becomes the campus hottie.
Kim overhears some shocking news after moving in with her father.
After accidentally injuring Professor Oglevee, Nikki becomes his round-the-clock nurse.
Acting on a rumor that the local football team is moving, a crazed fan takes the bar hostage.
After an argument with his wife of 49 years, Malcolm's grandfather arrives to stay with him and Eddie.
Eddie offers to take over at the bar so Malcolm can dine with his girlfriend's wealthy father.
Ticket scalping gets Malcolm and Eddie jailed on the eve of Martin Luther King Day.
An unruly customer challenges Eddie to a fight; Nicolette and Holly try being roommates.
While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.
Regina and Warrington's (Wendy Raquel Robinson, guest star Dorien Wilson) spat leaves Steve and Cedric (Steve Harvey, Cedric "The Entertainer") out in the cold.
From Exec. Producer Nas. Music meets the mean streets in this tale of three friends looking to escape their lives in Cleveland. Starring Machine Gun Kelly and Erykah Badu.

A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience.  Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.
After being released from prison a man finds himself caught up in a love triangle.
Who delivers ten times out of ten? Samuel L. Jackson is SHAFT, the man and the movie. John Singleton ("Boys 'n' the Hood") directs this gritty, action-packed thriller.

After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programmes.t: Tyler Perry's Madea Goes to Jail
programmes.d: At long last, Madea returns to the big screen! This time, America's favorite irreverent, pistol-packin' grandmomma is raising hell behind bars and lobbying for her freedom.
A pistol-packing grandma tries to hold a family reunion, a funeral, and a wedding all in the same weekend.
Jon helps Justin and Michael, a pair of strippers who own The End Zone bar in Houston, put aside their differences before they lose more than just their shirts.
Jon tries to motivate the inattentive owner of a failing Portland, Oregon, music venue plagued by mismanagement and an ant infestation.
Maria Menounos helps Jon scout a deeply indebted L.A. beer bar where the owners are divided about whether to throw in the towel and sell or keep plugging away.
Jon's attempt to save the YNot Sports Pub & Grub gets off to a bad start when there isn't enough staff on hand for a stress test.

programmes.st: Bar Rescue Two Tickets to Paradise Cantina
programmes.d: In his hometown of Las Vegas, Jon rescues a beloved party bar that blames their downfall on the pandemic until Jon discovers the truth.
Rescuing the Russell City Grill & Sports Bar was already going to be a challenge, but a violent brawl makes Jon question if it's even worth saving.
A former psychologist turned bar owner attempts to run a Detroit jazz club, but her interfering family and lazy staff have her seeking counseling from Jon.
Jon steps in to save J.A. Murphy's, a dive bar in Fell's Point, MD, on the brink of financial and physical collapse.
The eccentric owner of Brix Wine Bar is too busy being the life of the party to notice his business is withering on the vine.
The timid owner of City Bistro in St. Louis, MO, looks the other way as her raunchy bartenders flash customers to drum up business.
An outrageous owner spends more time swinging from the rafters than managing his bar, and Jon is ready to abandon the rescue if the owner doesn't face reality.
Jon must help a Yankee family learn to do business in the South if he hopes to save the poorly themed Characters Quarters in North Carolina.

programmes.st: Don't Judge a Booze by Its Bottle
programmes.d: Jon faces a real challenge with Cashmere Nightclub in North Carolina, where the wild manager thinks it's OK to sell cheap booze from pricey bottles.
A family-owned bar is put at risk when a son's excessive drinking and poor management choices begin to attract an X-rated clientele.
Jon visits a Las Vegas dive to teach the owner of Jack's Place how to act less like a mother and more like a boss.
Jon heads to Katy, Texas, to save Bryant's Ice House, which is plagued by a bad reputation, an even worse location and a wild staff.
Jon schools the clueless owner of Grinders, whose unauthorized and unsafe renovation has the city threatening to shut the place down.
A supply patrol discovers a hospitable planet; Baltar, Lee, and Kara find themselves in an awkward triangle.
As the fleet prepares to battle the Cylons for control of Kobol, the tensions between Adama and Laura explode.
With Adama wounded and Laura Roslin in the brig, Tigh faces his first test of leadership.

Hattie, Troy, and Drew try to babysit Baby Celina.
In the series finale, Sam and Drew explain their feelings for each other.
Suzanne enlists in a salsa-dancing class with Nick, but her controlling nature soon becomes an issue.
Suzanne helps a professional baseball player develop a charity event, but Nick is thrown a curve when he gets jealous of the two being together. Ice Cube and Jaleel White guest star.
Kevin gets roped into taking a test for a peer, spinning into motion various complications.
Suzanne reaches out to a relationship expert, then comes to believe that she and Nick have compatibility issues.

programmes.st: The Good Cop, Bad Cop Episode
programmes.d: When Suzanne gets tired of playing the role of bad cop to Nick's good cop, she makes it Nick's job to say \\"No\\" to the kids for an entire week.
Ashley returns from Texas after Don gets a DUI, Terrence proposes to Danielle again, and Charmaine goes behind everyone's backs to put herself in charge of Loyal Ink.
Charmaine has a mutiny on her hands after she announces new rules for the shop, Van and Jenn have an explosive fight, and Ryan has a special Mother's Day surprise for Rachel.

When Sky announces a Black Ink Prom, the competition for who will be King and Queen gets fierce. Q works with Crystal to get Ceaser back. One of Donna's tattoo clients sends a threatening letter to the shop.

programmes.st: The Problem With Torture Is Everybody Confesses
programmes.d: The crew is still reeling from the disastrous prom when Ceaser's most prized possession turns up missing. He launches an investigation into the potential thief which leads to some surprising decisions. Sky's son Des tries to track down his mom.

The news of Sky's suspension rocks the crew while Donna can't accept her apprentice demotion. Ceaser gets political and organizes a voter drive while Q faces a reckoning when his mom visits. Ceaser declares war on Ryan from 9MAG.

programmes.st: Dogs are More Loyal than Kits
programmes.d: Ceaser fumes over the video with Ryan and Kitty and plots revenge. Donna attempts to get her job back. Bae gets set up by a matchmaker and finds an unlikely bond with Rok. Walt and Jess' engagement party goes wheels off.
After a disastrous engagement party, Walt and Jess attend premarital counseling while the rest of the crew encourage Bae to face her biggest fear - confronting her abusive father.
Ceaser and the 113th crew travel to Philly for a tattoo convention and run into some frenemies. Jess has second thoughts about the wedding and Bae meets with her father one last time.

Ceaser fires his shot at Ryan and the two confront each other in a showdown. Relationship issues continue to worry Donna and Alex, while Walt has his own tale of woe. Ceaser receives news that could threaten the very existence of Black Ink New York.

Ceaser and the crew are still reeling from the news that the landlord wants them out of 113th in 30 days. Ceaser decides to do everything in his power to save the shop. Meanwhile, Donna has an uncomfortable chat with Tati, and Walt hits rock bottom.

programmes.st: Niko's Going to Have a Cousin?
programmes.d: Walt and Jess decide on a destination wedding but when nobody responds to their invite they reach out to other friends from their past. Ceaser continues to deal with the prospect of losing 113th and the crew discovers Ted might have a wife.

Walt and Jess have a destination wedding in Hawaii. The 113th crew surprise the couple on the island but Ceaser gets the biggest surprise of all. Alex plans a big surprise of his own for Donna but Tati's secrets threaten to blow up everything.

programmes.st: It's Like Rain On Your Wedding Day
programmes.d: On the season finale, the crew attempts to keep it together for another day in paradise while Cease refuses a surprise reuniting with loathed O*hit. Kit defies pressure from Donna and Tati to leave the island. Alex finally pops the question to Donna.
After the New York city shutdown, Covid and the loss of his first Black Ink shop, Ceaser has a new lease on life and is determined to get the crew back together.
Things come to a head after Ceaser & Teddy confront Walter about the 125th break-in. Puma opens up about his pandemic anxiety, while Bae reveals she's been dealing with a severe illness.
Walt talks to Jess and deals with the consequences of his actions. Donna takes her CBD business to new heights, while Tatti continues to fight to regain her manager position.
Bae is officially back at the Brooklyn shop. Ceaser decides to relocate the entire crew to Atlanta but Puma's nerves get the best of him when someone tests positive for COVID.

When Danny takes a call from a woman who is threatening to kill herself along with the man who killed her parents in a drunk driving accident, he rushes to find her.

Danny and Baez investigate when an expectant mother is a victim of a 'knockout game,' in which teenagers punch unsuspecting civilians in the head. Meanwhile, Frank wrestles with promoting an officer when he thinks it can be viewed as favoritism.

Danny and Baez investigate the death of a woman whose body was dumped after she was killed by a lethal dose of lidocaine following secret plastic surgery. Meanwhile, Frank privately assigns Jamie a cold case and Erin tries out speed dating.
Danny and Baez investigate the murder of a respected college professor who was involved with a questionable scholarship program.

When Erin is assigned to investigate a case in which an on-duty police officer is accused of killing a suspect already in custody, Frank urges her to stick to the facts to avoid a publicity scandal for the NYPD.
When a detective from Danny’s precinct is killed while working undercover, Frank puts on a full-court press to find his killer, only to discover that the deceased had a big secret.
When Danny is placed on modified duty after investigating a case that was off-limits, he realizes he stumbled upon something that someone is trying to keep quiet.
As Danny and Baez escort confiscated drugs to a remote location for incineration, their convoy is attacked and Baez is seriously injured, leaving Danny to track down the drug cartel responsible.
Danny and Baez are temporarily assigned new partners when an officer is outed and his current partner won't ride with him.

Boomer Esiason will appear as himself when he pays a visit to Commissioner Frank Reagan (Tom Selleck) at his office. Reagan thanks Esiason for his work with the Women and Kids Fundraiser and asks if there is anything he can do for him in return.
When Danny is charged with using excessive force, Frank must decide whether to stand up for his son or for the reputation of his police force.
Jamie is targeted by a vengeful thug after he intervenes in his abusive relationship with his girlfriend.

Frank and Danny are determined to put away an international felon who repeatedly manages to walk away from murder charges, but they struggle to come up with the necessary evidence to earn a conviction.

Frank is blindsided during an on-air interview when he and the interim District Attorney disagree over an issue. Meanwhile, Danny's new boss rides along with him, but their methods and personalities clash as they investigate a drive-by shooting.

Frank faces public backlash after an officer's body camera malfunctions during an altercation with a civilian. Meanwhile, Danny and Baez struggle to protect an informant after the U.S. Marshall's Service decides not to put him in Witness Protection.

As Danny and Baez investigate the murders of three prominent community leaders who appear to be the casualties of hate crimes, Frank meets with a group that wants to make sure these incidents are not taken lightly.
Danny is conflicted when he learns that a group of highly trained Army veterans are responsible for a robbery.
The Ponderosa becomes a war zone when it is invaded by a detachment of Mexican mercenaries under General Diaz.

Hoss comes upon an overturned stagecoach and discovers a little girl suffering from shock.  After the Cartwrights suceed in bringing her around, Hoss is disappointed she has relatives and cannot stay.
Adam takes a shine to Rebecca Kaufman, the daughter of a Jewish peddler, and bandits are convinced the Kaufman wagon is worth robbing.
So the Cartwrights will not be killed, one of Ben's oldest friends must make sure Joe does not win a horse race.
Joe struggles to understand whether his friend was right in killing a dying man who pleaded to put out of his misery.
After his only friend is killed, the Cartwrights take in a slow-witted man, who Roy Coffee informs them, is wanted for murder by Arizona authorities.
Ben's attempt to rehabilitate an alcoholic singer he knew in better days are complicated by her involvment with a former prize fighter.
Everyone feels Andy Walker is an outstanding singer but his father, who feels the boy should concentrate on ranch work instead.  Joe mentions receiving a letter from Adam, currently in Paris.
Ben helps Matthew Raine, a famous painter who has gone blind and now wallows in self-pity, discover a new purpose in life.  However, Raine's employee Gavin has other ideas.
The Cartwrights attempt to straighten out the snobbish young son of Ben's cousin.
Lafe Jessup doesn't really want to be married, and now he's about to be a father!  The horse wrangler finds a fight with Hoss at his reluctance to perform his duties.
A conman heads into town and takes advantage of the Cartwrights with a fake land deal.  The conman ends up staying in Virginia city to run an orphanage.
Hoss finds a kindred spirit in Skeeter Dexter, a lonesome young man who feels closer to animals than most people.
Joe and Adam protect a saloon girl, who has killed in self-defense, from an angry lynch mob.
A man who looks similar to Joe uses Joe's name and gets Joe in the position of facing the firing squad.
An author is inspired to write about the heroic Cartwrights after watching first-hand as they fight off an attempted robbery of a stage.
The Ponderosa hands are upset when new hand George Whitman is hired on, it is rumored he is a jinx.  Hoss tells George to ignore such foolishness, but a gypsy fortune teller says otherwise.
The Seventh Hokage gives Kawaki a last shot and assigns him to join Shikadai and Cho-Cho on a mission.
Cho-Cho is injured in an attack by a mysterious ninja and the item that Mozuku had been holding is stolen.
Traveling merchants have been attacked by vicious robbers, and Team 15 is sent to investigate.
With Denki as captain, Team 5 is assigned to a mission to transport automated puppets for mining purposes to an island in the Land of Water.

programmes.st: The New Team 7 Jumps Into Action
programmes.d: The new Team 7, including Kawaki, is assigned to escort Katasuke to a ceremony in the Land of Water.
Boruto is visiting the prison when an airship explodes during the ceremony.
Team 7 joins up with a unit led by Kagura and sets out for Dotou Island to assist Team 5 and rescue the islanders.
A giant mobile fortress appears before Boruto and his friends. Kagura orders Boruto, Kawaki, and Buntan to sneak into the fortress to gather information
Kagura, Hebiichigo and Kyoho show up to assist Boruto, Kawaki and Buntan, and they do what they can to destroy the weapon to protect their friends.
There is a murder aboard the ship that was meant to carry the people rescued from Dotou Island, and Kyoho is the primary suspect.

programmes.st: The Boy from the Isle of Shipbuilders
programmes.d: The ship carrying Boruto and his friends is dead in the water. The shipbuilder Kajiki and his apprentice Ikada pass by and offer to repair the ship.
Boruto joins Ikada as he sails to a factory where they can get a component needed for ship repair.
Ikada promises to achieve his dream and pay Boruto a visit. Buntan, Hebiichigo, and Kyoho wait for word on their reduced sentences.
Seiren appears before Boruto and torments him with her persistent attacks. Can Boruto find his way out of this predicament?!
A coded message believed to have been left by Funamushi reveals that the Hidden Mist Village is in danger.
Kagura releases the curse placed on Buntan, Hebiichigo, and Kyoho, temporarily setting them free.
Boruto and the others stand by to slow down Funamushi’s approach.
Boruto and the others manage to get Funamushi’s squad to retreat, but at a heavy price.
Araumi declares that he will be taking full command in the battles to come.
Funamushi’s squad shows up once again to attack the village.
Boruto and his friends manage to triumph over Funamushi, but they aren’t able to savor the victory.
Ikada returns home after learning that his sister has been severely injured in battle.
Araumi officially declares war against the Land of Water.
Sarada, Mitsuki, and Boruto decide to meet with the Mizukage.
Boruto, Sarada, and Mitsuki go meet with Ikada.
Boruto’s desperate attempts to reason with Ikada fail.
The pirate rebellion that has shaken the Land of Water is brought under control.
Cho-Cho and Inojin help out a Rogue Shinobi who owns a ramen shop.
Naruto has been asked to play himself in the popular Evil Jammer Kagemasa shinobi movie series.

programmes.st: The Uzumaki Family’s Hot Springs Vacation
programmes.d: Boruto and Kawaki join Naruto, Hinata, and Himawari on a family trip to the hot springs.
Mitsuki worries when Mikazuki the cat goes missing.
While strolling through the village, Kakashi and Boruto come across some people arguing.
Kawaki enrolls at the Ninja Academy and begins classes as a freshman with Himawari.

It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing… on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft-misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

McGarrett's investigation of a murder is thwarted by a computer which has been fed with erroneous information in hopes of diverting the guilt for the crime away from the guilty party.

programmes.st: A Woman's Work is with a Gun
programmes.d: Three troubled women take up armed robbery aboard scenic tour buses as a moneymaking project. The three women: Dina Hale, a lady with a hidden habit; Fay Scott, the mother of a desperately ill child; Margaret Hudson, an unhappily married housewife.

When Five-O nabs a shantytown ragamuffin for a minor theft, it sparks friction between McGarrett and a dedicated but impetuous female deputy public defender. The interference snags McGarrett's attempt to hide and protect the child from a hired killer.
The one-million-dollar reward offered for the return of five rare figurines touches off a global trail of murder and robbery that leads directly to McGarrett's jurisdiction.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Tibbs and Sweet investigate a woman who has been beaten and left for dead on the banks of a local creek. Tibbs, in particular, takes an interest in this possible wife-beating case and, in the process, unlocks part of his difficult and painful past.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Detective Virgil Tibbs and Chief Bill Gillespie investigate a murder of a father of two very different daughters who are caught up in a case of intense sibling rivalry...one that may have led one or both of them to murder.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Virgil (Howard Rollins) and Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) are faced with a violent labor strike at the local Sparta river plant. And tension runs even higher when a local city councilman is murdered when he tries to intervene between the two sides.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Tensions run high in the police department and in Sparta when Bubba is accused of attacking a black woman. And when a second woman comes forward from Bubba's past with similar claims, Virgil steps in to try and help clear his name.
Jesse's new part-time job as a trainer of the pro basketball Mustangs turns deadly when he's accused of murdering a star player.
Dr. Sloan investigates a plastic surgeon when an actress's death apparently results from an infection contracted during surgery.

The Sloans run into plenty of industry politics when they investigate the death of television network executive, Rachel Woodrall. Seamy revelations about Woodrall's college sorority lead to the killer.

Masked men kill members of a wealthy family and film the murder. They use the video to extort money from other wealthy families. Walker and Alex use the governor's plane to fly evidence to the court. Their plane is shot down.
An undercover agent is killed by Jack Garrett, the man she was working on. Walker sends an informant to get Garrett to incriminate himself but before he could someone tries to kill Garrett.

A for-hire explosive expert is hurt in one of his own explosions. The Rangers learn he was hired for a local job, and they want to find the man who hired the Iceman. The Rangers ask Charlie Brooks to play the Iceman due to a resemblance.

The Rangers bust up a drug operation. While the leader and his sick girlfriend escape, their son is found locked in a closet where he was forced to live. Ranger takes the boy under his wings to give him a life while tracking the parents.
Kimble accepts a job as a custodian at a private boy's club and finds his boss is an ex-cop.

programmes.st: The Good Guys And The Bad Guys
programmes.d: Kimble is arrested for not wearing western attire during "Pioneer Days" in a small town, then while in jail, his nemesis, Lt. Gerard is brought in for the same offense.
Kimble hitches a ride on a truck, and when he wakes up, he finds himself about to drive into a state penitentiary.
While vacationing on the slopes, MacGyver and Pete Thornton become targets of a mob "hit" squad.

programmes.st: Jack Is Back (Aka "Dalton, Jack of Spies")
programmes.d: MacGyver and his rapscallion buddy Jack Dalton are back together again this time they are up against a CIA agent gone bad and his cohorts, who are smuggling top-secret documents out of the country.
MacGyver and Pete Thornton find themselves right back where they were seven years ago -- up against a top-level, world-class assassin whom they believed dead.
Mark and Amanda are assigned to the task force investigating an airplane crash. An adversarial FBI agent and Russian mobsters make their assignment more difficult.
Steve and Ron lead the chase for the stolen nuclear material.

Jesse finally reunites with his father. After they narrowly elude an assassin, Jesse begins to realize his father isn't the accountant he's always claimed to be, but rather a spy. The Travis's attempt to discover who's sending the killers.

programmes.st: A Mime Is A Terrible Thing To Waste
programmes.d: A dead mime leads to an investigation of a crooked auto dealer. Randy Wolfe, a woman who's apparently an expert at everything, leads the investigation while continually annoying Steve.
Mrs. Elkins turns Dennis down for a job delivering circulars for her campaign, but Mr. Wilson agrees to help Dennis pursue it.
Following a complaint from Mrs. Elkins, Sgt. Mooney takes Mr. Wilson to court for an alleged violation of a town ordinance when his incinerator continues to burn after 8:00 a.m.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Art Of Romance
programmes.d: Bud asks Jim how to get Judy's attention while Judy asks Margaret how to get Bud's attention.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Margaret Disowns Her Family
programmes.d: Margaret helps out a young pregnant woman.

Margaret's father decides to retire because of help problems.  However, when Margaret and Jim figure out what is the real source of his sickness, her father will have to decide if he really wants to stop working.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Shoot For The Moon
programmes.d: The Andersons regain their confidence with the help of Sageman.
The twins compete for Uncle Bill's undivided attention. Each seems to think he likes the other twin better.

Bill is scheduled to take Freddie out to dinner, but also has to go to the twins' open house at school. Bill takes Freddie to the school, and she just loves it. She starts to think she wants to have children of her own.
A new family moves into the apartment building where the Davises live. Stanley is a child with a physical disability that hinders his walking. Buffy and Jody try to be friends with him at school.
Someone new moves into the apartment building where the Davises live, and it is a Broadway star. Buffy and Jody can't keep their eyes off her.

programmes.st: The Not So Rose Colored Glasses
programmes.d: Mike and Carol receive disturbing news of an eyewitness account that Jan stole someone else's bicycle from the park.

Bobby develops a Napoleon complex, especially after Greg has to save him from a situation caused in part because he ended up doing something he wasn't supposed to since he was too small to handle the job.
Greg loses a bet to Bobby and has to be his slave for a week.
Peter writes a newspaper column to win points with his teacher.
Alice’s tough-as-nails cousin fills in while she is out of town.
Carol’s minor parking lot accident turns into a court case.
Archie and Mike head down to the store to get some items and on the way out Archie witnesses a mugging. Archie doesn't want to get involved in the matter and refuses to tell the police what he saw.

Edith answers the door to find a woman on the stoop with a young boy. The woman mentions that she's dropping Mike's son off and leaves. Edith now finds herself in the awkward position of explaining to the rest of the family where the boy came from.

Mike and Gloria go away for eight days to spend some time in a commune. Archie and Edith settle down for a quiet game of cards but when she lets him win, Archie insults her and they get into a big fight.

Edith gets a package in the mail, a mink cape sent to her as a 'thank you' gift by her Cousin Amelia for Edith taking care of her after a surgery. When Archie sees the cape, he takes it the wrong way and demands that she give it back.

To get some extra cash, Archie has gotten a job driving a taxi. One of his passengers turns out to be Sammy Davis Jr. Sammy inadvertently leaves his briefcase behind and arrangements are made for him to retrieve the briefcase at the Bunker house.

Archie comes home from the laundromat in fury. It seems that he overloaded one of the machines causing the machine to eat his clothes and cause a flood. The irate proprietor of the laundromat, soon stops by to get Archie to pay for the damages.

Gloria is reading over an old love letter that Mike had sent her. This leads to a conversation between Gloria and Edith concerning an old flame of Edith's. Archie hits the roof and demands that Edith not keep any secrets from him.
Edith's cousin, Maude, invites Archie and Edith to the wedding of her daughter, Carol. However, Carol and Maude are not looking forward to Archie, since the man she is marrying happens to be Jewish.
After going to a cousin's funeral, Mama plans a suitable funeral for herself. However, it will require their savings for vacation and for her to bow out of the bowling competition.
When Mama claims to have a date for Valentine's Day, Iola resorts to "Rent A Gent," but she gets a much younger and much better looking escort than she expected.
While Mama disputes a bill, the electric company turns the power off—the night that Bubba has to finish a paper on Abraham Lincoln and Iola is up for an award at the Food Circus.
Mama finally gets the house to herself when everyone goes away for the weekend. But the peace and quiet is far from the paradise she expects.
It's April Fool's Day, and Mama is in a foul mood. She hates practical jokes but gets the last laugh on the rest of the family when she pulls the best joke ever.

programmes.st: There's No Place Like … No Place
programmes.d: At a rally with no identification, Mama is arrested with people who are homeless. She finds her cousin Cora, who lost her farm, and discovers her cellmates are people much like her.
When Mama discovers the president of the Church Ladies League cannot read—and this is the reason for her mistakes—Mama starts a program in the church to teach adults to read.
When an IRS agent stops by to deliver Mama's $250 refund, he realizes that she has been less than truthful on her tax returns and will now owe back taxes, interest, and penalties.
When a con artist tries to swindle Vint, he doesn't count on Mama. She dons a wire, takes a bag of unmarked dollar bills and goes undercover for the local police.
The Paris Opera Ballet performs the work choreographed by Rudolf Nureyev.

The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.
By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.
Iconic music from movies and series such as "Babylon Berlin" and "The Great Gatsby."

programmes.t: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
